title: Hirriba Qajeelotaa
intro: Yeroo amantiin balaa qabuu fi warri humna qaban amantii caccabsuu barbaadanitti, gareen xiqqaan lubbuu dargaggootaa filannoo bara dheeraa keessatti sagalee ta’u godhan. Hunda beekan baqatanii dukkana gaara dhokataa keessa maganfatanii guutumatti Rabbiin irratti imaanaa kaa’an. Wanti itti aanee ta’e warra xiinxalaniif mallattoo yeroo hin qabne ta’a ture.
clues: Nuti garee dargaggoota Gooftaa keenyatti amanne waan turreef, qajeelfama nutti dabale.
Ummata keenya dura dhaabannee gonkumaa Rabbiin alatti waaqa kamuu akka hin waamnu labsine.
'Yaa Gooftaa keenya araara ofirraa nuuf kenni, dhimma keenya keessattis sirritti nu qajeelchi' jennee holqa tokkotti kooluu galle.
Waggoota baayʼeedhaaf kan rafne siʼa taʼu, aduun holqa keenya irraa fagaattee nu hin tuqne.
Sareen keenya seensa holqichaa irratti diriiree akka waan dammaqeetti nu eegaa ciisee ture.
Yeroo dammaqnu hammam akka turre waan yaadneef, tokko keenyas nyaata bitachuuf saantima meetii qabate ergame.

arabic: وَلَبِثُوا۟ فِى كَهْفِهِمْ ثَلَـٰثَ مِا۟ئَةٍۢ سِنِينَ وَٱزْدَادُوا۟ تِسْعًۭا
verse: And they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine. (18:25)
